2027 Concacaf Nations League Semifinal Matchups and Schedule Confirmed

11/18/2026 - 12:07 PM
Semifinal Schedule confirmed

Tickets for the 2027 Nations League Finals are on sale at CNLFinals.com/tickets.

  • Concacaf Nations League Finals will feature USA vs Mexico and Canada vs Panama in the Semifinals
  • SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles will host the Semifinals on March 25 and the Third-Place Match and Final on March 28
  • Tickets for the 2027 Concacaf Nations League Finals will go on sale to the general public on November 18 at 10 a.m. PT via CNLFinals.com/tickets
  • Matchups also confirmed for the inaugural Concacaf Nations League B and C Championships
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 4:42
Instaread

Miami, FL – Following the conclusion of the 2026/27 Concacaf Nations League’s League A Quarterfinals, Concacaf has confirmed the semifinal matchups and match schedule for the 2027 Concacaf Nations League Finals, as well as the matchups for the inaugural League B and C Championships.

The fifth edition of the Concacaf Nations League Finals will bring together the men’s national teams of Canada, Mexico, Panama, and the United States at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles, California, from March 25 to 28, 2027.

The competition will kick off with the Semifinals on Thursday, March 25, featuring United States (1) vs Mexico (4) and Canada (2) vs Panama (3), followed by the Third-Place Match and Final on Sunday, March 28.

Tickets for the 2027 Concacaf Nations League Finals will go on sale to the general public on Wednesday, November 18, at 10 a.m. PT via CNLFinals.com/tickets.

To determine the semifinal matchups, Concacaf has ranked the four participating national teams 1-4 based on points accumulated during the Quarterfinals. The highest-ranked team will face the lowest-ranked team (1 vs 4), while the second-ranked team will face the third-ranked team (2 vs 3).

2027 Concacaf Nations League Finals Rankings

  1. United States (6 pts, +8 gd)
  2. Canada (6 pts, +4 gd)
  3. Panama (4 pts, +2 gd)
  4. Mexico (3 pts, 0 gd)

2027 Concacaf Nations League Semifinals

  • Semifinal #1: United States (1) vs Mexico (4)
  • Semifinal #2: Canada (2) vs Panama (3)

The semifinal winners will advance to the Final to compete for the 2027 Concacaf Nations League title, while the semifinal losers will compete in the Third-Place Match.

The United States claimed the competition’s first three titles (2021, 2023, and 2024), before Mexico lifted the trophy for the first time in 2025.

Additionally, the four Concacaf Nations League Finals participants have secured direct qualification for the revamped 2027 Concacaf Gold Cup, scheduled for June 17 to July 11, 2027.

2027 Concacaf Nations League Finals Schedule

*Kickoff times listed in ET (local)

Thursday, March 25, 2027 – Semifinals

  • 19:00 (16:00) Canada vs Panama
  • 22:15 (19:15) United States vs Mexico

Sunday, March 28, 2027 – Third-Place Match and Final

  • 17:15 (14:15) Loser SF1 vs Loser SF2
  • 20:30 (17:30) Winner SF1 vs Winner SF2

2027 Concacaf Nations League – League B Championship

Following the conclusion of the League B Group Stage, the four group winners – Cuba, Guyana, Saint Lucia, and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines – have advanced to the inaugural Concacaf Nations League B Championship, which will take place in March 2027.

The four national teams, which have also secured promotion to League A and direct qualification for the 2027 Concacaf Gold Cup, will compete in a centralized competition to crown the first-ever League B champion.

The semifinal matchups were determined based on group stage performance, with the highest-ranked team facing the lowest-ranked team, and are as follows:

  • Semifinal #1: Guyana (1) vs Cuba (4)
  • Semifinal #2: Saint Lucia (2) vs Saint Vincent and the Grenadines (3)

The semifinals will take place on Friday, March 26, 2027, followed by the Third-Place Match and Final on Monday, March 29, 2027.

Concacaf will announce the host venue and kickoff times at a later date.

2027 Concacaf Nations League – League C Championship

The inaugural Concacaf Nations League C Championship will feature the three League C group winners – Antigua and Barbuda, Montserrat, and Saint Martin – and the best second-place finisher, Aruba. All four national teams have also secured promotion to League B, and will compete to crown the first-ever League C champion.

The semifinal matchups were determined based on group stage performance, with the highest-ranked team facing the lowest-ranked team, and are as follows:

  • Semifinal #1: Montserrat (1) vs Aruba (4)
  • Semifinal #2: Saint Martin (2) vs Antigua and Barbuda (3)

Following Aruba’s qualification for the 2027 Concacaf Gold Cup Prelims, the League C Championship, originally scheduled for March 2027, will now take place in June 2027. The semifinals will take place on Wednesday, June 9, 2027, followed by the Third-Place Match and Final on Saturday, June 12, 2027.

Concacaf will announce the host venue and kickoff times at a later date.
